recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for this issue unless a later work-group decision changes Resource.language and XHTML lang/xml:lang validation guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-18485 asked to add language to all published resource instances because the narrative page said a lang attribute on the XHTML div SHOULD also be used. The final Published/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution instead changed that SHOULD to apply only if language is declared on the resource and noted validator warning follow-up.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to GH#df47b32c6c. That commit changed source/narrative.html from the unconditional SHOULD to the approved conditional wording and made a typo cleanup in source/languages.html. Current blame still traces source/narrative.html:165 to df47b32c6c, with later narrative link cleanup preserving the wording.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively maps narrative and xhtml type pages to the narrative page, making source/narrative.html current build-scoped source. A later Zulip IG-creation thread shows the validator/publisher side treating missing XHTML lang/xml:lang on resources with Resource.language as a warning/generation concern, consistent with the Jira note. Direct FHIR-18485 Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current narrative page already says the div lang attribute SHOULD be used if language is declared on the resource, which is the work-group's final disposition; adding language to all examples would contradict that narrowed resolution.
